data.rationale: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Accrued Traffic Income + Prepaids
Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Deferred Income
Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Other Reserves
Accrued Income & Prepaid Traffic = Unbilled Traffic + Prepaid Operator Balances + Contract Assets
Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Goodwill & Intangibles + Other
Non-Current Liabilities = Bond & RCF + Deferred Tax + Provisions & Earn-outs
Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Lease Payments + Dividends & Buy-backs
Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions

data.expression: SUM(cf-ni, cf-da, cf-dar, cf-dinv, cf-dap, cf-dwc)
data.rationale: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit After Tax + D&A + Working Capital
Termination & Delivery Cost = Operator Termination + OTT Channel Fees + Routes, Delivery & Hosting
Depreciation & Amortisation = Platform Hardware + Right-of-Use + Software & Acquired Intangibles
Adjusted EBIT = EBITDA − D&A
Adjusted EBIT Margin % = EBIT / Revenue x 100
Adjusted EBITDA = Gross Profit − Operating Expenses
Adjusted EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Revenue x 100
Profit Before Tax = EBIT + Net Financial Items
Free Cash Flow = CFO + CapEx
Gross Profit = Revenue − Termination & Delivery Cost
Gross Margin % = Gross Profit / Revenue x 100
Profit After Tax = Profit Before Tax − Income Tax
Net Margin % = Profit After Tax / Revenue x 100
Net Financial Items = Finance Income − Finance Costs + FX & Other
Operating Expenses = Sales & Marketing + Platform & Technology + G&A
Revenue = Gross Messaging & Platform Revenue − Credit Notes & Volume Rebates
